summary: WF International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a Termination Agreement with The Benchmark Company, LLC and Axiom Capital Management, Inc. dated August 19, 2026. The company agreed to pay $100,000 in cash to terminate the placement agents' right of first refusal (ROFR) from a November 4, 2025 placement agency agreement. The ROFR covered future equity/debt offerings and merger or acquisition transactions for twelve months post-closing. The termination does not affect other terms of the placement agency agreement. This is a routine contractual resolution, not a special situation; no strategic event or shareholder impact is indicated.
